items.q: How do I run Cypress tests on TestMu AI?
items.a: Install the TestMu AI Cypress CLI, run init to create the config, add your credentials and run with the parallels you need.

items.q: Which browsers support Cypress testing on TestMu AI?
items.a: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Electron, in multiple versions.

items.q: Can I run Cypress tests in parallel?
items.a: Yes. Specs are split across parallel sessions; the number depends on your plan.
Yes. The automation free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions.

items.q: Is this the same as Cypress Cloud?
items.a: No. Cypress Cloud is Cypress's own dashboard service. TestMu AI runs your specs on its browser grid and records the results.
